title: Native command provenance and completion
implementation: Discover commands/completion by host/provider/cwd/native session and actual source. Keep plugin/skill/template/project commands; reject blocked builtins without navigation or model forwarding. Selective rewrite of donor sections 8/22/27/33 only: no builtin query handlers, generic native_action gateway, Pending/Admission/JoinSet framework, presets/roles/BTW/Vibe imports, or Task31 OpenCode changes. AgentSession::input_refusal returns a typed, input-correlated pre-admission fact. Manager settlement appends its explanation without scanning provider events or starting/interruption of a native turn; existing durable receipts settle Rejected. First delivery and replay return invalid_message. Catalog and completion keys include connection identity and provider/cwd/native session; native commands_changed events cancel and invalidate both queries. Unloaded/invalidated ownership never permits destructive client shortcuts. Supported empty native completion hides the menu.
acceptance: Same-name plugin collisions survive builtin filtering; metadata-derived hints never enter submitted/copied/saved text; draft queries create no agent; completion and execution preserve source ownership and downgrade.

adr: ADR-242 (proposed; Draft PR is not architectural review approval)
compatibility: Command catalog entries add optional source/aliases/menuVisible/menuAliases, keeping ownership independent of menu eligibility. New agent.commands.complete method negotiates by capability; not_implemented/unsupported falls back to catalog filtering, supported zero-item completion hides the menu. Native commands_changed uses the existing Agent stream and invalidates catalog/completion queries. All current callers consume the updated contract; no compatibility aliases or generic admission framework. Blocked-builtin input receives a typed input-correlated local refusal and Rejected receipt, with invalid_message on first delivery and replay. ADR-242 contains the boundary ledger.
